title: Onboarding runbook or curriculum generator
description: Creates role-specific onboarding plans with learning objectives, practice, assessments, and owner sign-off.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: onboarding-runbook-curriculum
  title: Onboarding runbook or curriculum generator
  description: Creates role-specific onboarding plans with learning objectives, practice, assessments, and owner sign-off.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Deliver a practical onboarding experience tailored to role and operating context.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 2
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - program-owner
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Role, audience, and source materials
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - role
          - audience
          - materials
          - duration
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: analyze
      kind: agent
      name: Identify required competencies
      role: Learning designer
      prompt: Extract role outcomes, skills, systems, policies, stakeholders, and common failure modes from source materials.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - teaching
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: curriculum
      kind: agent
      name: Build onboarding curriculum
      role: Instructional designer
      prompt: Create sequenced modules, objectives, exercises, checkpoints, resources, managers, and time estimates.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - teaching
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: validate
      kind: agent
      name: Validate operational readiness
      role: Role manager
      prompt: Confirm curriculum covers day-one, first-week, and first-month readiness. Identify gaps and required local
        adaptations.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: program-owner
      kind: approval
      name: Program owner approves runbook
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Onboarding runbook, curriculum, and assessment checklist
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: analyze
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: analyze
      to: curriculum
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: curriculum
      to: validate
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: validate
      to: program-owner
      kind: dependency
    - id: e5
      from: program-owner
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
